notes: «سألت ابن عباس» : Abu Nadra asked and Ibn Abbas answered, so Ibn Abbas is a link (rule 5); «أبي، نضرة» is one man (rule 7).
«فأخبرت أبا سعيد» then «قال فوالله لقد جاء بعض فتيان رسول الله» gives a second saying relayed by Abu Sa'id with no isnad of its own: not added here, flagged for ruling (two sayings in one report).
«قال أوقال ذلك» is the narrator's own doubt about the wording, not a link.
